displayAddress: Bank Street, Sheffield, South Yorkshire, S1
description:
Welcome to 36a Bank Street a beautifully designed, three-bedroom luxury apartment located in the heart of Sheffield City Centre.

Nestled within one of the city’s oldest and most characterful streets, this stunning home combines history and heritage with fresh, contemporary design.

Behind its classic Georgian façade lies a space that has been meticulously transformed by the current owners, creating an effortlessly stylish city residence ready for modern life. Inside, the apartment offers three spacious double bedrooms, main bedroom having an en-suite shower room, each filled with natural light and thoughtfully laid out to offer both comfort and functionality.

The open-plan living area forms the heart of the home a sociable and striking space that flows seamlessly to a sleek, fully fitted kitchen, complete with integrated appliances and modern finishes. Whether you're entertaining, working from home or enjoying a quiet night in, this apartment delivers on all fronts.

The shower room is a particular highlight, boasting a double shower enclosure with bold, contemporary design a space that feels more boutique hotel than city centre flat. There’s also excellent storage throughout and premium touches that set this apartment apart.

But it’s not just the interior that impresses. A secluded outdoor patio provides a rare slice of calm in the city, while a shared, glass covered internal courtyard offers an additional outdoor space for relaxation and socialising, exclusive to residents of this development. The basements offer a significant amount of secure additional storage and are available exclusively to residential owners of the two apartments in the building. There is no Ground Rent and the apartments will benefit from amongst the lowest Service Charges in the city via a joint Freehold ownership and the purchasers will be part of a unique development, enjoying a say in how communal parts of the building are run and managed.

A Unique Opportunity in a Prime City-Centre Spot Bank Street is steeped in history, once the centre of Sheffield’s booming commercial district. Today, it’s a highly sought-after residential location, moments from the Cathedral Quarter, Kelham Island, Fargate and the soon-to-be transformed Castlegate regeneration zone. Living here means having the best of Sheffield at your doorstep  whether it's artisan coffee, fine dining, riverside walks or a night at the theatre.

Excellent transport links are just a short walk away, with tram and bus stops nearby, and Sheffield train station within easy reach. Both universities and major employers are close at hand, making this property ideal for city professionals, looking for a prime piece of Sheffield real estate.

Although no allocated parking is included, convenient options are available nearby. The owners currently rent a permanent space just a few minutes walk away. 

Additional Benefits: Opportunity to acquire a share of the freehold. Energy-efficient and low-maintenance living and move-in ready. An ideal stylish owner-occupier home. This apartment is a true hidden gem blending style, location, and quality living in one of Sheffield’s most exciting and evolving neighbourhoods. With properties of this calibre rarely available, now is the time to act. To arrange your private viewing, contact the expert team at Reeds Rains City Living Sheffield. You simply have to see it to appreciate everything this home has to offer.
